script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Warns when no cluster token is set and installs the libraries the server needs when the host does not have them.

script.name: Add the Workshop mod to the server
script.description: Lists the mod in dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua and enables it in modoverrides.lua

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the server
script.description: Removes the mod from dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua and modoverrides.lua and deletes its download
